model: Carlin EZTemp 51110A7 electric water heater control
applies_to: Bock electric water heaters fitted with the Carlin EZTemp 51110A7 control.
summary: The Carlin EZTemp 51110A7 is the electric water heater control Bock uses, with BACnet MS/TP on board. Its object list is short: three temperature sensors, heating-stage and relay states, operating mode, the active error and a three-deep error history as multistate inputs, an enable/disable multistate value and the setpoint as an Integer Value.
notes: Only MV 12 (Enable Mode) and IV 3 (Set Point) are writable.
Multistate state numbers are given in the order the PICS lists the state texts, starting at 1.
IV 18 is printed with the name 'Error 2 File Number', the same as IV 17; by position it is the error 2 line number.
The MS/TP Network Port object (instance 22) supports 9600 and 38400 baud; MAC address, link speed, Max_Master and Max_Info_Frames are writable there.
Device profile B-SA, BACnet protocol revision 19; segmentation supported.

source.title: BACnet Protocol Implementation Conformance Statement, Carlin EZTemp 51110A7

integration.summary: Enable the heater with MV 12 and write the water temperature setpoint to IV 3 (100-182 °F). Read the temperature sensors, the heating state (MI 1), the operating mode (MI 11) and the active error (MI 2).
integration.enable: MV 12 Enable Mode enables or disables the heater from BACnet.
setup: MS/TP at 9600 or 38400 baud; MAC address, baud, Max_Master and Max_Info_Frames are writable in the Network Port object (instance 22).
gotchas: The setpoint is an Integer Value object (IV 3), which some older front ends do not support.

points.name: Control Status
points.states: 1 = HEAT_OFF, 2 = HEAT_ON_REQ_1, 3 = HEAT_ON_REQ_2, 4 = HEAT_ON_REQ_3, 5 = HEAT_ON_1, 6 = HEAT_ON_2, 7 = HEAT_ON_3, 8 = HEAT_OFF_REQ_1, 9 = HEAT_OFF_REQ_2, 10 = HEAT_OFF_REQ_3

points.name: Control Error Code
points.states: 1 = None, 2 = Safety relay fail on, 3 = Output 1 relay fail on, 4 = Output 2 relay fail on, 5 = Output 3 relay fail on, 6 = Safety relay fail off, 7 = Output 1 relay fail off, 8 = Output 2 relay fail off, 9 = Output 3 relay fail off, 10 = Temperature Sensor 1 open, 11 = Temperature Sensor 2 open, 12 = Outdoor Temperature Sensor open

points.name: Operating Mode
points.states: 1 = Version display mode, 2 = Soft lockout mode, 3 = Lockout mode, 4 = Latchup mode, 5 = Normal mode, 6 = Display mode, 7 = Setting mode, 8 = Diagnostic start mode, 9 = Diagnostic mode, 10 = Modbus mode

points.name: Error 2 File Number
points.description: Diagnostic line number for error 2 (name printed as File Number)
